query: Create a simple todo REST API in Node.js: a todo controller with CRUD endpoints (list, get, create, update, delete) backed by an in-memory store.
expected_behavior: Sets up a test runner (for example node:test) before writing any controller or store code
Writes a test for the first endpoint, runs it, and shows it failing for the intended reason before implementing that endpoint
Repeats the red-green cycle for each CRUD operation instead of implementing all endpoints first
Runs the full test suite green at the end and smoke-tests the API through its real entry point
Final report names the tests observed failing before their production change and the failure reasons

query: Add a `priority` field to todos: low, medium or high, defaulting to medium. It should be settable when creating and when updating a todo.
expected_behavior: Reads the existing tests in test/todos.test.js to follow their conventions before editing src/
Adds tests for the default priority, setting it on create and on update, and rejecting invalid values, and runs them failing before editing src/
Implements the field in src/store.js and src/app.js with the smallest change that makes the tests pass
Runs the whole suite with npm test after the change and reports the result

query: Can you make `GET /todos` support filtering by status, like `GET /todos?completed=true` or `?completed=false`?
expected_behavior: Writes tests for completed=true and completed=false (and ideally an invalid value) before editing src/
Runs the new tests and shows they fail because the list is unfiltered, not because of a syntax error
Implements filtering with a minimal change and keeps unfiltered GET /todos behavior unchanged
Runs npm test green and reports the red evidence for each new test
